emma (People Ops): Heads-up 0 Rafael relocated NY -> NJ mid-pay period (effective 2026-06-16). His 6/15 pay shows split withholding and a duplicate 401(k) deduction + an unexpected garnishment line. @dan can you confirm what's in the payrun?

dan (Payroll): Looking at payrun 2026-06-15 job 33455. System split earnings but also applied NJ resident tax to full period and double-deducted 401k due to a duplicate employee record. Garnishment flagged from legacy vendor mapping V-9988. We should reverse garnish, correct 401k, and run an off-cycle net make-whole. Need relocation docs + manager approval. Codes I'll use: `OFFCYCLE_TAX | GL:6120 | TAG:reloc-tax-split`.

rafael (Employee): Confirmed moved 2026-06-16. Uploaded lease + utilities to HR folder (onboard/rafael/reloc). Net pay short ~$432. Also I don't have any child-support garnishment in place 2 that's worrying.

sara (Manager): I approve off-cycle to make Rafael whole. I'll confirm move date here. The garnishment seems wrong 2 @priya can you check vendor mapping?

priya (Finance Ops): Checked vendor ledger 2 looks like vendor V-9988 (legacy contractor entity) was incorrectly linked to Rafael's new payroll ID during conversion. We'll unlink and reverse if funds still in bank. We'll need Rafael to sign a short attestation that no garnishment applies and to provide ID for the reversal. I'll request JE too.

tax-bot: Payrun 33455 flagged: `duplicate-401k`, `garnishment-mapping`. Ticket created: PAY-33455.

dan (Payroll): I'll prepare off-cycle to reverse the garnishment (if remitted we'll coordinate recovery), remove duplicate 401k contribution, and credit net $432. Need manager sign-off + attestation + JE id. Also will check if Box 16 on W-2 may need amendment depending on year-to-date adjustments.

emma (People Ops): Approved. Rafael please upload the signed attestation and confirm NJ withholding start date (2026-06-16).

rafael (Employee): Attestation uploaded and lease attached. Confirm NJ withholding started 2026-06-16. Also pinged my old contractor PM to request vendor unlink.

dan (Payroll): Off-cycle queued as job `33890`. Please confirm JE id. I'll tag `reloc-tax-split` and add note: "reverse duplicate 401k + garnish; net credit to employee".

priya (Finance Ops): JE created: JE-2026-333 "Reloc tax/garnish correction - Rafael". Docs uploaded to finance drive.

tax-bot: Off-cycle job queued: 33890. Link: https://payroll.redwood.com/jobs/33890 :clipboard:

dan (Payroll): Off-cycle processed 2 Rafael credited $432 today. Garnishment reversal submitted to bank 2 may take 5-7 business days to reflect. I'll update if any remitted taxes require further reclaim workflows or W-2 adjustments.

rafael (Employee): Got the $432 credit this morning. Garnishment return pending. Huge thanks everyone :tada:
